title: An MHD Riemann Fan for a Solar EUV Front
equations: 1D ideal adiabatic MHD; isotropic pressure; constant Bn; no gravity, heat conduction, radiation, resistivity or ongoing driver forcing

coordinate_system.normal: positive n points from assumed driver/shell side toward ambient corona; exact heliographic normal is unspecified
coordinate_system.velocity: plasma velocity, not EUV pattern speed
coordinate_system.initial_discontinuity: x=0 at t=0; homogeneous LEFT for x<0 and RIGHT for x>0
coordinate_system.event_epoch: not assigned; t is model age, not a measured launch time

composition: fully ionized pure hydrogen, Te=Tp; p=2ne kB T; rho=ne mp

LEFT.provenance: ASSUMED; thermal pressure MODEL_DERIVED from assumed ne,T and composition

RIGHT.provenance: ASSUMED; thermal pressure MODEL_DERIVED from assumed ne,T and composition

suggested_numerical_domain.boundary: fixed original LEFT/RIGHT reservoir states; boundaries outside the fan
suggested_numerical_domain.warning: Initial moving LEFT reservoir is only a local surrogate for a piston; it is not a measured time-dependent piston boundary condition.

difference_from_main: Only initial LEFT temperature changes from 2 to 1.5 MK; pressure and total energy follow. All other dimensional initial inputs are unchanged.
